title: Card: a definition, a lower third or a name tag
description: The channel's one box form: 24 px rounding, paper at 96 % with a soft ink shadow and a 10 px accent edge on the left; line 1 in the display font (the name or the term, 72 px), line 2 in the body font (role, source or a short explanation, 54 to 60 px). It sits in the lower third on the free side, right-aligned at the safe edge, its lower edge 86 px above the frame. mark: a thin highlight band behind line 1 (a definition). variant "tag": the name tag of a proof film (ink at 90 %, no shadow, one paper line, low on the left). The card pushes in from the speaker's side, each line 2 frames later.
